prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. EMPTY insert: two drawers of wrapped confection compartments. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: Show exactly two drawers with front ribbon pulls, bottom drawer pulled out farther.
